items.title: Lost Soul
items.description: As you move forward, you see a husk of a man sitting in front of a slot machine, desperately trying to reach a bucket of coins at his side. The machine has one more spin in it. What do you do?

choices.label: Get Him Out
choices.outcome: You get a shoulder under his arm and walk him to the door. He does not thank you. Somewhere between the machine and the daylight, your own chest loosens.

choices.label: Take the Bucket
choices.outcome: He does not even look up as you lift it. The coins are warm, which is somehow worse than if they had been cold.

choices.label: Spin The Machine
choices.summary: Take the last spin for yourself
choices.outcome: You pull. The reels go around one final time, and the old machine gives up whatever it had left.

items.title: Risky Dealings
items.description: You find yourself in front of a cash machine, glowing with lights. As you look for a way to make some coin, you see the opening has sharp teeth on it. What could possibly go wrong?

choices.label: Just the Finger
choices.summary: Lose 1 HP per encounter, gain 3 coins per encounter
choices.outcome: In and out. The teeth close a half-second late and take a strip of knuckle with them. You have had worse from a bad hand.

choices.label: The Entire Hand
choices.summary: Lose 3 HP per encounter, gain 7 coins per encounter
choices.outcome: You go in to the wrist. The machine pays, and it bites, and for a moment you genuinely cannot say which hurt more. You leave rich and dripping.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.summary: Your blood is worth more than coin
choices.outcome: You put your hands in your pockets and keep walking. Behind you the lights keep glowing, patient, for the next one along.

items.title: Guarded Treasure
items.description: As you sneak around, you find a guarded side room with an artifact stored in a glass case. Looks expensive.

choices.label: Go For It
choices.summary: Fight the guards. Win, and the relic is yours
choices.outcome: The nearest guard sees you. So does the one behind him.

choices.label: Play It Safe
choices.summary: Swallow your pride and walk away
choices.outcome: You count the guards twice, then count them out of it. The case is still there in your head an hour later.

items.title: Quick Catch
items.description: You see a very rich patron with two full pockets. One has coins falling from it, and one has an unknown item. As they look away, you have just enough time to reach out for one of them.

choices.label: Go Left
choices.outcome: Coins, and plenty of them. They do not notice, or they do not care, and both spend the same.

choices.label: Go Right
choices.outcome: Your fingers close on something with weight to it. You are three rooms away before you look.

items.title: Cheap Tricks
items.description: A dark figure in a suit and a top hat approaches you from the shadows. In their hands are four cards. "Pick a card, any card," the figure says with a devious smile. Which one should you pick?

choices.label: Left Card
choices.outcome: A spade, inked so black it looks wet. The figure bows.

choices.label: Middle-Left Card
choices.outcome: A club. The figure seems almost disappointed for you.

choices.label: Middle-Right Card
choices.outcome: A heart, and a wink you were not meant to catch.

choices.label: Right Card
choices.outcome: A diamond. The hat tips, and the shadows take the rest.
